entities.summary: Jaeahn Hwang clan is one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Hwangju County, North Hwanghae Province. According to the research held in 2015, the number of Jaeahn Hwang clan's member was 3098. Their founder was Hwang Eul gu, a great-grandchild of Hwang Seok gi. Hwang Eul gu’s ancestor was Hwang Bo who was a Lu (state) people in China. Hwang Eul gu passed Imperial examination during Goryeo period. Then, he worked as Ijo. After that, he became one of the Gongsin members and became Prince of Jaeahn.
